beats.text: Solomon earned twenty tonnes of gold yearly?
beats.scene: Painted golden throne room of Solomon in warm torchlight, camera sliding forward. Overlay: counter 20 tonnes.

beats.text: The Bible says it plainly: six hundred sixty-six talents.
beats.scene: Servants carrying heavy golden vessels up temple steps at dusk. Overlay: counter 666 talents.

beats.text: One talent is about thirty to thirty-four kilograms.
beats.scene: Large stone weight beside a balance scale in lamplight. Overlay: weight badge 30-34 kg.

beats.text: Do the maths: roughly twenty to twenty-three tonnes.
beats.scene: Mountain of gold bars in a treasury, torchlight glinting. Overlay: counter 20-23 t.

beats.text: A gold bar weighs about twelve kilograms. Picture lifting one.
beats.scene: Pair of hands straining to lift a single gold bar. Overlay: weight badge 12 kg.

beats.text: Solomon's year equals about sixteen hundred of those bars.
beats.scene: Rows of gold bars stacked in a vault, camera panning over them. Overlay: counter about 1,600 bars.

beats.text: At today's gold price, that is well over a billion dollars.
beats.scene: Modern open-pit gold mine at sunset with a single haul truck. Overlay: compare bar 20 t vs 3,600 t.
Golden caravan of camels crossing a desert ridge at sunset. Overlay: ratio badge about 0.6 percent.

beats.text: It came from trade, tribute and taxes, not only from mines.
beats.scene: Trade caravan unloading sacks at a city gate. Overlay: three counters trade / tribute / tax.

beats.text: Not proven: scholars debate whether the number is literal.
beats.scene: Scribe weighing a wax tablet in his hand, evening light. Overlay: question mark badge.

beats.text: And the number has a famous echo: 666.
beats.scene: Gold coin glinting in shadow with Solomon's throne behind. Overlay: counter 666.

beats.text: So was Solomon's gold literal or royal exaggeration?
beats.scene: Solomon's throne in golden light, camera slow push. Overlay: choice tags A literal / B exaggeration.

youtube.title: Solomon's 666 Talents of Gold Explained #shorts
youtube.description:
1 Kings 10:14 says Solomon received 666 talents of gold in one year. How much is that in tonnes?
Scholars debate whether the number is literal or exaggerated.
#Solomon #Bible #Gold #BibleHistory
